name: Recital 1
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing an EU talent pool
part_text: (1) The Union and Member States are facing temporary shortages in certain sectors. These shortages must be addressed as a matter of priority by activating the unemployed or underemployed national and European workforce, through retraining and by improving working conditions and wages. These measures must be complemented by an ambitious natalist policy in order to respond to the structural demographic challenge.
